add-column: The non-volatile constant jsonb default uses PostgreSQL's fast-default catalog path without rewriting decision rows; lock acquisition is bounded by 5s and the statement by 30s.
replace-view: The two decision views re-expand their existing SELECT * definitions to include extraction_warnings while preserving the redaction and listing filters; replacement updates view metadata without scanning corpus rows, under 5s lock_timeout and 30s statement_timeout.
